dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave curvature on the trailing edge forming a smooth parabolic spline from the dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphological point with a moderate pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 50-degree incline relative to the horizontal dorsal plane.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.2:1 ratio of base width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Convex, semi-circular melon boundary with a uniform curve radius.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Elongated, slender beak with a high length-to-thickness pixel ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Distinct obtuse angle where the melon slope transitions to the rostrum base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Single circular white/depigmented patch visible on the dorsal-lateral surface posterior to the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible caudal flukes extending toward the lower right frame and a prominent pectoral fin with a rounded distal margin.
